crosswalks.label: Information Security Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Information Security Analysts ground adversarial/security assessment practices while AI Red-Team Specialist narrows to authorized AI behavior and safeguard testing.

crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers ground system/test implementation but do not own adversarial risk evaluation.

findings.summary: AI red-team work must preserve explicit authorization, controlled test environments, exact system/safeguard identity and separation between observed failure, inferred risk and risk acceptance.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialist boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make authorization, bounded-reproduction and finding-versus-risk-acceptance boundaries explicit before using AI red-team capability.

nonclaims: No complete AI Red-Team Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
